selection: Purposive three-topic pilot: spaceflight, game release, and policy decision; active two-sided quotes, archived rules, one deadline within two weeks and all within 2026. Selected before independent forecasts, not on forecast disagreement. Not representative of all Kalshi markets.
baseline: YES bid-ask midpoint from baseline.json, captured before workers start. Last trade and spread reported separately.
forecast_policy: One fresh-context independent forecast per question; no market price supplied; independently chosen joint scenarios; preserve exposure declarations.
scoring: Binary Brier (p-y)^2; matched per-question difference model minus fixed market midpoint, lower is better. Exclude unresolved, canceled, nonbinary, materially changed contract, and known-before-issuance cases. No accuracy winner until outcomes; no significance claims at n=3.
timing: Research occurs after baseline snapshot; capture a secondary market snapshot after forecasts to disclose drift. Not exactly simultaneous information.
portfolio: Paper comparison only; no orders or holdings.
